title: Inference Traction Compass & Field Evidence Lab
creator: Maya Patel
description: Create a repeatable playbook and lightweight evidence lab that captures vendor traction signals, real-world adoption evidence, and procurement triggers for inference models. The deliverable is a field-ready 'Compass' artifact: (1) a signal taxonomy and scoring rubric, (2) a canonical profile template for each vendor/variant, (3) an ingestion checklist to capture sales/SE/CS inputs, and (4) a dashboard prototype that surfaces regional traction, latency-sensitive verticals, and quantization/compatibility friction. This ticket focuses on PM research, rubric definition, and a clickable dashboard mock with representative datasets rather than full infra ingestion.
acceptance_criteria: Signal taxonomy with 12 primary signals (supply, latency, pricing, quant-compat, legal, docs, partner traction, reported incidents, throughput benchmarks, enterprise SLA adoption, region availability, customer references) documented in Confluence
Scoring rubric that yields a 0-100 'Traction Score' with explanation of weights and failure modes
Three vendor/variant profiles completed (one open quantized variant, one hosted provider, one private/on-prem offering) with provenance notes and links to source evidence
Dashboard prototype (Figma + simple Looker mock or Storybook) that shows Traction Score by region and by vertical and supports filtering by signal type
Playbook checklist for field teams (sales/SE/CS/solutions) with sample interview questions and evidence capture format
tasks: Draft signal taxonomy and weight proposal (Maya)
Collect initial evidence for 6 vendors from public sources + customer conversations (Liam + Research intern)
Design profile template and approval from Head of PM (Maya)
Prototype dashboard with sample dataset (Design + Analytics)
Validate rubric with two sales reps and one solutions engineer (field trial)
Write Confluence playbook and attach example filled profiles
